messages:
Alice: Quick Q: proposing to change who can access raw request/response traces (full payloads) in S3. Current: dev+sec. Proposal: restrict to incident response + designated analysts via JIT, retention 90d raw + 365d redacted. Thoughts? cc @Cara @Ben
Ben: Agree w/ restriction. Cost impact + retention tradeoffs. 90d raw seems ok. Can we tier: 14d hot, 76d cold? :thinking_face:
Cara: Compliance: for auth logs + forensics we need 1yr retention for certain customers (PCI/SO). So redacted 1yr for customers in scope. Need policy that tags customer-owned data. Suggest 90d raw only.
Evan: We should enforce access via IAM role `security/jit_raw_access` with external ID and approval workflow. Also require KMS re-wrap on export. Example policy:
```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":"s3:GetObject","Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::redwood-raw-logs/*","Condition":{"StringEquals":{"aws:PrincipalTag/approved":"true"}}}]}
```
Alice: For the approval workflow: IR ticket + 2nd approver from Sec Eng. Access expires automatically after 4 hours. We should log export SHA256 and store in audit bucket.
DevOpsBot: policy-doc uploaded: https://internal.redwood/doc/sec/raw-trace-access (uploaded by Alice) :file_folder:
Iris: For active incidents we often need immediate access. Can we add emergency override with pager duty approval? It should be recorded and require post-incident review.
Ben: Emergency override OK, but must create ephemeral snapshot w/ redaction pipeline that strips PII unless explicitly needed. Also we need RBAC mapping: 'security_raw_viewer' vs 'security_raw_admin'.
Frank: Legal: any exports containing customer PII need customer consent unless it's for security incident. Keep a checklist for exports. Also ensure DSAR process can find exported artifacts.
Evan: Implementation note: use S3 object tagging + lifecycle + KMS key policy that denies GetObject unless `aws:PrincipalTag/approved=true` is present. Snippet:
```yaml
Statement:
  - Effect: Deny
    Action: s3:GetObject
    Resource: arn:aws:s3:::redwood-raw-logs/*
    Condition:
      Bool:
        "aws:PrincipalTag/approved": false
```
Cara: We'll need to update the Data Retention policy doc and include an exceptions matrix. I can draft.
Alice: Thanks all. Action items: Evan - IAM/KMS snippet PR; Ben - cost estimate + lifecycle rules; Cara - policy update; Iris - define emergency override play; Frank - legal checklist. I'll open a follow-up thread for the PR and SOC review. :+1:
AuditBot: created ticket #SEC-4217 for tracking.
